window.rule: The integration or analysis window is a committed multiple of the cited libration period.
window.secular_basis: 4 turns of the precessing apse, the turns counted from the first-order theory's own rate (limit stated in leg S1)
window.refusal: a window that has not seen 3 completed libration periods (a secular window that has not seen 3 turns) returns state 'not-constrained' with no period (no rate), whatever else the series looks like

methods.argument: For a p:q resonance the kernel builds the argument from mean longitudes and longitudes of periapsis of 3-D elements about the primary in the primary's equatorial frame (lambda = Omega + omega + M, varpi = Omega + omega); the integer coefficients sum to zero or the argument is refused.
methods.libration_estimator: smooth the unwrapped argument over one conjunction cycle (the Io-Europa synodic period 3.525 d for the Laplace argument; the Pluto-Neptune synodic 491.5 yr), find turning points with a prominence of 12% of the smoothed span and a floor of 0.002 deg (Laplace) or 0.5 deg (Pluto), period = twice the mean spacing of successive turning points, amplitude = half the mean max-min, with ANGLE_CRITERIA otherwise as committed in js/resonance/elements.js except stationaryDeg = 0.002 (Laplace)
methods.period_uncertainty: sigma_P = 2 sd(turning spacings) / sqrt(k) for k >= 2 spacings, in quadrature with a sampling floor of 1 d (Laplace) or 20 yr (Pluto); a coverage interval is +-2 sigma
methods.secular_rate: slope of the unwrapped apsidal longitude by least squares over the window; sigma is half the difference of the slopes of the two halves
methods.integrator: js/lab3d/kernel.js yoshida4, fixed step: 0.0221 d (Laplace model and pack runs), 1.0 yr (Pluto model), 0.09 yr (secular test); samples every 1 d, 20 yr, 5 yr
methods.oracle_integrator: scipy DOP853, rtol 1e-11 atol 1e-14 (Laplace rtol 1e-10), the same initial state, sampled on the same grid, its own elements code, its own libration estimator

S1f and S2f failed because h = 0.02 yr still carries a numerical apsidal advance (kernel 6.13e-4 rad/yr against the oracle's 5.87e-4; the error scales as h^4 from the 1 deg per year seen at h = 0.1, so about 0.0015 deg per year at h = 0.02).
